name: lensden-explorer
description: Read-only current published Lensden AR/AI glasses, source-linked details, comparisons and published guides. Preserve generations, regions, variants, Unknown and conflicts.

interface.longDescription: Search current published Lensden devices, inspect source-linked details, compare exact models and find deployed published English guides. Preserve generations, region/variant scopes, Unknown values and conflicts. No private accounts, purchases, live stock or prices, rankings, or compatibility certification. Device results report read-time provenance; guides reflect the deployed published content.
defaultPrompt: Find XREAL One models with Lensden sources.
Compare XREAL One and One Pro without hiding unknowns.
Find a USB-C display-glasses compatibility guide.

prompts: Compare XREAL One and One Pro and explain what the sources establish.
What should I check before connecting display glasses to Nintendo Switch 2?
Why can text look blurry in display glasses?

positive.description: Current published public identities with generations and canonical links.
positive.prompt: Find XREAL One models in Lensden.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the exact published One and One Pro identities, preserving returned generations, Unknown states, current data mode/freshness and canonical product links. Do not claim live stock or prices.

positive.description: Exact device detail with public evidence.
positive.prompt: Show Lensden details and sources for XREAL One Pro, slug xreal-one-pro.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the exact public slug and preserve parameter states, measurement context, region/variant scopes, source links and evidence. Do not infer missing facts or certification.

positive.description: Two exact models using the existing Compare destination.
positive.prompt: Compare XREAL One (xreal-one) and One Pro (xreal-one-pro) on eye brightness and panel/projector brightness.
positive.expected_behavior: Keep the two identities, eye/panel units and measurement contexts distinct; preserve Unknown and not-disclosed values and source links. Return the canonical Lensden Compare URL without inventing a winner.

positive.description: Published compatibility guide and primary references.
positive.prompt: Find the published Lensden USB-C display-glasses compatibility guide for XREAL One and One Pro.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the canonical published guide URL, review date, source links and connection-chain limitations. Guides reflect the deployed published content; do not claim external references were fetched live or that a connector certifies compatibility.

positive.description: Explicit conflict and missing-field handling in an exact public scope.
positive.prompt: Read xreal-one in the Global region and empty variant, fields basic.weight_g and basic.missing. Treat basic.missing only as a missing-field check.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the returned weight conflict and its evidence if still present; preserve Unknown for the intentional missing-field probe and the Global/empty-variant scope. Report actual current values rather than historical fixture values.

negative.description: Explain that private accounts, emails and messages are outside the plugin. Do not invoke a tool to retrieve private records or claim access.
negative.prompt: Show me the email addresses and private messages of Lensden users who own XREAL glasses.

negative.description: Explain that this read-only plugin cannot buy, reserve, change data or apply discounts. No purchase, account or mutation tool may be invoked, and no transaction may be claimed.
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest pair for me and update the Lensden price to my discount.

negative.description: Decline the unsupported guarantee; explain documentary and variant limits. Do not call a tool as if it certifies hardware or claim a physical test. Offer source-based research only after reframing.
negative.prompt: Certify that every Switch 2 adapter works with every AR glasses model because Lensden physically tested them all.

publication.release_notes: Lensden Explorer provides four read-only tools for researching published AR/AI glasses: device search, source-linked specifications, product comparisons, and compatibility guides. Results preserve Unknown values, conflicting evidence, and region or variant distinctions. The remote MCP server is publicly accessible over HTTPS without authentication. The plugin does not access private Lensden accounts, make purchases, provide live prices or inventory, or certify hardware compatibility.
